_comment_cron: Cron is configured in the Railway dashboard, not here. Set the schedule to '5 0 * * *' UTC so the run starts ~5 min after Solstice's 00:00 UTC snapshot publishes.
_comment_volume: Attach a persistent volume to this service at mount path /mnt/data. The slim DB lives there across runs.
_comment_env: Required env vars: HELIUS_ENDPOINTS (comma-separated RPCs), GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT), GH_REPO (owner/name). Optional: HELIUS_URL, SOLSTICE_DB (defaults to /mnt/data/solstice.slim.db).
